entries.title: Ledger integrity verification
entries.description: verify_chain_structure() recomputed each record_hash from the canonical body and re-derived the chain links, and no modification was detected; each record's Ed25519 signature was verified against the issuer's public key; suffix truncation and events that were never written lie outside both checks, because detecting them needs an anchor kept outside the file.
